title: Monitor Continuous-Action Range and Smoothness Drift
summary: An action can stay inside its allowed range yet jump too quickly between control ticks.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Normalized action units; timestamps seconds; max_speed normalized action units per second. Inputs must use the same normalization and controller frame as the baseline.

physical_contract.axes: Explicit batch, sequence and channel axes defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Caller-synchronized observations; generation time and physical control time are distinct.
physical_contract.batching: Explicit batch, sequence and channel axes defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original bounded engineering component motivated by the paper; no pretrained model or benchmark reproduction is implied.
